spoken_summary: Benjamin Flores gives a speech arguing for solidarity. He uses a rhetorical device, stating that if an unspecified 'they' labels a person named 'James' as 'trans,' then 'we're all trans.' He repeats this for other labels, saying if James is called a 'gay tofu-eating vegan,' then 'we're all gay tofu-eating vegans,' and if they say 'James is going to hell,' then 'we're all going to hell.'
